claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch on the current record based primarily on aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, despite an unresolved disclosure dispute for a named launch use case that misses target.
decision_criteria: A compliant certification requires admissible evidence that the material limitation for the named launch use case is either disclosed before launch or covered by approved risk acceptance.
If final legal review concludes disclosure is not required and that conclusion is documented, the verdict could change.
If certification is formally narrowed so the named municipal permitting assistant use case is excluded from launch commitments, the materiality analysis could change.
Absent one of those conditions, aggregate readiness evidence alone is insufficient under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: The actual model card or launch disclosure showing the municipal permitting assistant limitation is disclosed before launch.
An approved risk acceptance covering this named launch use case, if disclosure is not being made.
The final legal determination on whether disclosure is required.
The governing launch approval artifact showing whether certification scope includes or excludes the named municipal permitting assistant commitments.
specific_concerns: The affected municipal permitting assistant segment misses target and is explicitly named in two city pilot commitments, which makes the weakness material under the stated policy.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.

The policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and no evidence of either disclosure or approved risk acceptance is in the record.

Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness, but they do not cure the separate disclosure requirement for a material named-use-case limitation.
The product note calling the segment non-core because it is 7% of projected traffic does not resolve materiality where named commitments and pending legal review exist.
unsupported_claims: That certification is supportable on the current admissible record without first showing disclosure of the material limitation or approved risk acceptance.
That aggregate readiness plus monitoring is a sufficient admissible defense for certification of this named-use-case dispute.
Any implicit claim that the named-segment gap can be treated as non-material based on low projected traffic.
